book.name: iMatiu
book.title: Esɔ Osuse mi abɔ mgbi iMatiu

content: Igyila mgbi iYesu
Ta Onodzi Osaan kye iYesu lu okwɛsɛ ni iSatan ka mbadin.
Dafi iYesu tukwondu egbe ngwusefa yi otu ngwusefa nyɛ nɛ, enbwa dɔn.
Ta iSatan ba mbon wa nyan gbɛɛ, <<Kini abu li ongwɛ Imgbasho yɔ, wo akwutsɛ ntonɛ ola nu ma kyata yɛɛ ibredi.>>
Kpaa iYesu nun uka gbɛɛ: <<Afɛ lɔ gbɛɛ, inggisɛ ka dzɛ oshishe mi ibredi ta ba, kpaa li mi ali elodzɛ ntɔ mi ondu mgbi Imgbasho mani.>>
Ta iSatan di kyon lu ogalu osaan, kyon ka dɔkɛ ikyikye ozu osunu Imgbasho,
o nyan gbɛɛ, <<Ni abu li ongwɛ Imgbasho yɔ, bulu lu esɛ. Lubana Afɛ lɔ gbɛɛ,

content.text: <<Imgbasho ka wo engyesɔ mgban ola ikye abu,
a ka kye gbɛlu abu mi abɔ mgbi ama,

content: IYesu nyan gbɛɛ, <<Afɛ di lɔ gbɛɛ, <ka mbadi Otsɛ Imgbasho mgbi abu ba.> >>
ISatan di kyon lu ka tɔkɛ unggwɔ nshigbo kpakpa di tson esutɔ mgbi ɛsɛ duu bɛyi okwɔkwɔ mgbi ɛsɛ. O nyan gbɛɛ:
<<Kini abu kwɛsɛ sunu ani yɔ, ungwɔ ntonɛ duu n ka gbe nu abu.>>
Nghaduu iYesu nyan gbɛɛ, <<Yɛ enggengga iSatan! Lubana Afɛ lɔ gbɛɛ: <Sunu Otsɛ Imgbasho mgbi abu, di li ongwu ta kyɔn idɔ.> >>
Ta iSatan lu dzanta, man engyesɔ mgbi Imgbasho ba wa tobyun.
IYesu wita ogbeesɔ
Ngwi iYesu fwo gbɛɛ a kye iJɔn wokɛ obawi nɛ, o yɛ lu iGalalia.
O dzata iNadzareti si lu ka dzɛ iKapenahun ndzɛ mi ewuutɔ iGalalia mi ayɛ mgbi iDzebulun bɛyi iNaftali
ikye ombwumbwo odzɛ ngwi oyegbɔ Adzaya tsekise gbɔ mani gbɛɛ:

content.text: ama nlato iwulu ikwongye osa gbosa tu ma.>>

content: Wita mi onɔ na nghataa lu iyayi iYesu wita ogbeesɔ gbɛɛ <<kyata mi ali ibwubwe mgbi ema na, lubana esutɔ ongwi esho dzɛ kwɛkwɛ.>>
IYesu kwu engwafɔɔn emi ababɔ ela
Dafi iYesu le kyikyɛ nyɛ ewekyoo okwukwo mgbi iGalalia nɛ, o di engwuneka nghi efa, iSaimɔn nli iPyita nani bɛyi ongwunɔn Andru. A tole ngwi ukɛ mi utɔ lubana a li ama okwu mmbweni.
IYesu nya ma gbɛɛ, <<Ba, wa kyɛdɔ ani na, ta ani ka kyata ema yɛɛ ama okwu inggisɛ.>>
A byakpa dzata ukɛ mgbi ama kyɛdɔn.
O gble kiyayi nɛ, o di engwunɔ angbeka efa, iJɛnsi bɛyi ongwunɔn iJɔn emi ongwɛ iDzebedi. A woto uwaa yi otsɔma, le mɛ akɛ. IYesu kwu ma ela,
plɛ nɛta a dzita otsɔma bɛyi uwaa si kyɛdɔn.
IYesu ngyɛlu emi ootse ootse
IYesu kyikyɛ kpatsɛ iGalalia, le tso mi ozu okwakye mgbi emi iJuda, le gbɔ Esɔ Osuse mgbi esutɔ, dile ngyɛlu inggisɛ ootse idzidza-dzidza.

Odzɛ mgban si gbɔfwɛ kpatsɛ ali imbe mi iSiria, ta inggisɛ gbe ama ndotse ita idzidza-dzidza ba mbon, ama nle gyadzɛ yi owulu-wulu, yi ama ngwu esɛ dɔ ma ikye, ama odzɛkwulu yi ama ogbyikye tukwu esɛ, kpaa iYesu ngyɛlu ma ele duu.
Ijiji inggisɛ mi iGalalia yi iDekapoli yi iJerosalin yi iJudia bɛyi ayɛsɛ nto oyombo ekyoo iJodan duu kyɛdɔn.
